title: Comparable Accuracy, Divergent Hotspots: replication package (code, test points, derived data and pre-registration records)
description:
Replication package for Kaewpia, T.; Changruenngam, T.; Suantai, S.; Prommai, T.; Klinhnu, J. Comparable Accuracy, Divergent Hotspots: A Pre-specified Crossed Experiment on Background Radius and Algorithm Choice in Industrial-Location Suitability Mapping, Northern Thailand. Geographies (MDPI).

Contents: analysis code, the shared test points (restricted values removed), all derived result tables and post hoc outputs, the pre-declaration with Amendments 1-4 (six registry identifiers redacted), and SHA-256 records for every input, output and released file.

Not included: firm coordinates (DIW registry), the Royal Forest Department forest layer and the outputs derived from it, and the State Railway of Thailand planned-railway alignment and its distance raster. See README, section 'Available and not available'.
notes: Licensed by component: code under MIT; derived tables, pre-registration documents and integrity records under CC BY 4.0; the test points under ODbL 1.0 (values derived from OpenStreetMap). See LICENSE.
